summary: FD_TC_214_3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim NOT Opened � Non-EU Country � Rejected
title: 3rd Party � Claims Company � Claim NOT Opened � Non-EU Country � Rejected
description:
Validates that when a claims company submits and the passenger has NOT opened a claim, and the country is non-EU, the system rejects the submission.

Prerequisites:
Third-party caller type: Claims Company. Passenger has NOT opened a claim. Country of origin: Canada.
